blurb: Guests learn ballroom dance through a structured, membership-based program combining private lessons, group classes, and practice sessions. The studio caters to all levels from beginners to advanced dancers and offers specialty coaching and wedding dance preparation. Social dance events and showcases are also part of the experience.
